test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The new management repeated its committment to the development of the deprived.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Committment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the above sentence **Committment **is the incorrectly spelt word.
 
• There should be **Commitment **instead of **Committment**.
 
• The word **Commitment **means being dedicated to something.
 
• Example : I made a **commitment **to serve my country till my last breath.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Development **means the process of moving to further stage or being developed.

*Example *: The **Development **of country can be seen.

 
• The word **Management **means the act of dealing with or controlling objects or people

*Example *: Her **management **skill are appreciable.

 
• The word **Deprived **mean lacking something.

*Example *: I am **deprived **of sleep.
